text: Which domain name should the public server use?
context: One name serves the game (UDP 5000), the HTTPS token endpoint, `/healthz`, and the privacy and account-deletion pages (BRL-z277, BRL-71r3, BRL-tysh). It's baked into release clients as the default server, so changing it later means a client update. You need to own it (or a subdomain of a domain you own) and be able to create A records with a short TTL.

suggestions.text: A subdomain of a domain you already own
suggestions.detail: For example `play.<your-domain>`. Give the exact name.

suggestions.text: Register a new domain for the game
suggestions.detail: For example `pewpewblitz.<tld>`. Give the name you register.
